functions.name: research_company_intel
functions.title: Research company intelligence
functions.description: Generate a comprehensive corporate-intelligence snapshot for a company (listed, private, or subsidiary): valuation vs intrinsic value, index-passive lift, investors, investments, partnerships, corporate structure, and growth story. Use when the user asks to analyze a company. Subject to the signed-in user's daily AI quota (higher tiers get more calls).

query.description: Company name or identifier to research. 1-160 characters.

functions.name: research_ipo
functions.title: Research IPO profile
functions.description: Generate a detailed IPO research profile (filing status, offering price/size, valuation, underwriters, use of proceeds, growth story, risks, comparables) for a specific IPO or a regional IPO overview. Use when the user asks about an IPO or new listing. Subject to the signed-in user's daily AI quota.

query.description: IPO target (company name, ticker, or aggregate term like '日本のIPO 2025'). 1-160 characters.

functions.name: research_wealth_profile
functions.title: Research wealth profile
functions.description: Generate a global wealth/asset-intelligence profile (net worth, holdings, portfolio allocation, philanthropy, lifestyle, recent activity, history) for an individual, company, institution, fund, or sovereign entity. Use when the user asks to analyze a wealthy entity or asset holder. Subject to the signed-in user's daily AI quota.

query.description: Subject name (person, company, institution, fund, or sovereign entity). 1-160 characters.

functions.name: research_ai_snapshot
functions.title: Generate AI research snapshot
functions.description: Generate a real-time structured research brief (summary, key points, metrics, sentiment, sources) for a company, sector, market, or theme using the latest web information. Use when the user asks for a research brief or analysis on a topic. Subject to the signed-in user's daily AI quota.

query_type.description: Type of query. Defaults to company.

functions.name: generate_discover_feed
functions.title: Generate discovery feed
functions.description: Produce a discovery feed of timely topics across stocks, weather/disaster, geopolitics, science, and markets. Can be personalized to the signed-in user's watchlist and holdings, or a balanced default world overview. Subject to the signed-in user's daily AI quota.

mode.description: default = balanced global overview; personalized = tailored to the signed-in user's activity, watchlist, and holdings. Defaults to default.

functions.name: get_referral_stats
functions.title: Get referral stats
functions.description: Return the signed-in user's referral count and earned bonus quota. No parameters.

functions.name: record_referral
functions.title: Record referral
functions.description: Record that the signed-in user was referred by another user (deduplicated, self-referrals ignored). Use when the user provides a referrer id.
